name: muji-style-skill
title_zh: 给任意照片铺一层亚麻布纹理的日系静物滤镜
tagline_zh: 不用买道具、不用找场地，一张普通照片或一个抽象主题，就能生成无印良品感的海报、封面或产品图。自带克制配色与留白。
tagline_en: Turn any photo or abstract theme into a quiet MUJI-style visual — restrained color, honest texture, editorial.
desc_en: Create original quiet-living visuals from any theme, object, product, article, event, space, or supplied photograph using natural materials, restrained color, functional typography, asymmetric whitespace, honest photography, and human imperfection. Always use this skill when the user asks for MUJI-inspired, 无印良品感, 日系极简, Japanese minimalism, quiet living, natural minimalism, understated lifestyle d
why_zh: 它不靠滤镜模板，而是按自然材质、低饱和配色、功能字体和不对称留白重新构图。
why_en: It doesn't apply a filter — it rebuilds the image with natural materials, muted tones, functional type, and asymmetric.
limit_zh: 只处理单张静物/场景/产品图或单一主题；不生成多页排版，不重绘人脸特写，不处理复杂透视或强烈动态场景。
limit_en: Single still-life/scene/product image or one theme only. No multi-page layout, no face retouching, no complex perspective or high-motion scenes.
title_en: MUJI-style quiet-living visuals from any photo or theme
